newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia rubber falls at close on poor leads.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia rubber falls at close on poor leads.

text.p: Malaysian rubber prices fell further at the close after a fairly slow dealing day with lack of active paticipation and poor overseas leads dampening sentiment, dealers said.

"The market continued to lack inquiries from major buyers. There were scattered interest from Asia and Europe ahead of the summer holidays," a trader said. Some European centres were seen covering their positions but on a small scale.
Trading houses offered SMR CV at 337 cents a kg, SMR L at 315, SMR 5 at 275, SMR 10 at 265 and drum latex FOB at 229.
At the close, May RSS 1 buyer eased 1.50 cents to 282.50 cents ($1.13) a kg and May SMR 20 buyer was down a cent to 266.50 cents.
The INRO five-day moving average on April 22 was 215.50 Malaysian/Singapore cents per kg against 217.05 on April 21.
The daily indicator price was 212.06 against 214.01.

Dealers said that producers were seen quoting lower levels in order to attract overseas buyers. "Tokyo prices are still falling and we expect local prices to be cheaper," a dealer at a local trading firm said.
